claims.text: Current ELS's are not sufficiently effective due to unresolved ambiguities and irrelevant entities.
Extracted entities from ELS's may be ambiguous, leading to confusion in summarization tasks.
The linked entities can be too common or coarse, introducing errors and irrelevance to summaries.
